name: Camping Bergkristall
beschreibung: Camping Bergkristall is located in the village of Prägraten in the Virgental in Osttirol. The site is surrounded by the mountains of the Venedigergruppe and lies at an altitude of around 1,300 metres. The site offers level pitches for motorhomes and caravans, which can be connected to a clean electricity supply. A separate tent meadow is provided for guests with their own equipment. The sanitary building is equipped with underfloor heating and offers barrier-free access. Numerous hiking routes start from here into the Nationalpark Hohe Tauern. In winter, the nearby lifts in the surrounding area are used for skiing.
